name: upstream-smoke
command: import json,sys; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,"src"); from dual_rec.monitoring.upstream import original_smoke; r=original_smoke(); Path("results/monitoring-study/20261111T121002Z/phase_a_smoke.json").write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+"\n"); print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))

name: prepare-public-tasks
command: import sys,json; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,"src"); from dual_rec.monitoring.benchmarks import prepare_tasks; rows=prepare_tasks(Path("results/monitoring-study/20261111T121002Z/benchmarks")); print(json.dumps([{k:r[k] for k in ("task_id","family","split")} | {"plan_length":len(r["plan"]),"atoms":len(r["model"]["atoms"]),"excluded_groundings":len(r["excluded_groundings"])} for r in rows],indent=2))

name: correct-consequence-metadata
command: import sys; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,"src"); from dual_rec.monitoring.benchmarks import refresh_consequence_metadata; refresh_consequence_metadata(Path("results/monitoring-study/20261111T121002Z/benchmarks")); print("Consequence metadata corrected; immutable original and correction journal retained")

name: analysis-final-checks
command: uv run --no-sync ruff format --check src/dual_rec/monitoring/analysis.py tests/test_monitoring_analysis.py && uv run --no-sync ruff check src/dual_rec/monitoring/analysis.py tests/test_monitoring_analysis.py && uv run --no-sync pytest -q tests/test_monitoring_analysis.py

name: environment-versions
command: import json,platform,sys,importlib.metadata as m; print(json.dumps({'python':sys.version,'platform':platform.platform(),'versions':{n:m.version(n) for n in ['numpy','pydantic','pytest','ruff','mani-skill','sapien','mujoco','torch']}},indent=2))
